text: {"danger_level":"red","danger_reason":"Air-raid sirens indicate an active, severe city-wide threat of aerial bombardment.","main_move":"GO_DOWN_INSIDE","main_move_text":"Move immediately to a ground floor interior room or basement away from windows and doors.","where_to_go":"Stay where you are in Tansi Nagar and shelter in the lowest available interior floor or basement.","do_now":[{"text":"Assist children, elderly, and vulnerable individuals to a safe ground floor interior hallway or windowless room immediately.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_SHELTER_01"]},{"text":"Shut all exterior doors and windows, and draw heavy curtains or blinds.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_SEAL_01"]},{"text":"Turn off gas connections and electricity mains if safe to do so quickly.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_UTILITIES_01"]}],"do_not":[{"text":"Do not stand near windows, outer walls, glass structures, or top floors.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_DONOT_01"]},{"text":"Do not go outside or use elevators during an active siren alert.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_DONOT_02"]}],"if_you_are":[{"situation":"With elderly people, children or someone who needs help","text":"Guide them slowly to a central windowless room on the ground floor, seating them against an interior wall with cushions for protection.","advice_ids":["AIR_RAID_ASSIST_01"]}],"call":["112","100","1077"],"confidence":"high","confidence_reason":"Air-raid sirens demand immediate indoor blast shelter actions.","unknowns":["Exact duration of the alert","Specific blast target locations"],"valid_while":["Air-raid alert remains active","Until official all-clear announcement"]}
